_comment: What the server tells a caller of a delegation wider than its parent, by the rule it broke: the message is the title of the capability library's problem, then ": ", then the detail named here, the library's own constant for that rule. sdk/go/paladintest holds every detail to the library's limes.Narrows, and the Python fake answers with the same.
title: The delegation asks for more than its parent holds

details.audience: the audience is wider than the parent's
details.tenant: it names another tenant than the parent
details.key_bound: the parent is bound to a key and it is not
details.op: an op is not among the parent's
details.resources_unrestricted: the parent restricts resources and it does not
details.resource_prefix: a resource prefix is not under the parent's
details.resource_uri: a resource URI is not among the parent's
details.tainted_read: it allows tainted reads and the parent does not
details.idempotency_key: it drops the parent's idempotency key requirement
